ownership.businessAuthority: Reserved notification authority for email, SMS, push, and commerce lifecycle messaging.

observabilityAuthority.audit: notification dispatches must retain template, recipient, and provider event references without secret payloads

executionAuthority.executionRole: Execution container for APIs, workers, webhooks, schedulers, queue consumers, and runtime bootstrapping.
executionAuthority.orchestrationRole: Delegates business workflow sequencing to packages/application-services; owns transport invocation and runtime transactions only.
executionAuthority.infrastructureOwnership: May wire packages/infrastructure adapters to runtime bindings and secrets; does not import provider SDKs directly.
executionAuthority.eventOwnership: Owns runtime event ingestion, dispatch, acknowledgement, and handler execution for declared service responsibilities.
executionAuthority.queryOwnership: May execute service-side read models through application-services or runtime-composition contracts.
executionAuthority.compositionOwnership: No UI composition authority; composes execution handlers and response envelopes only.

orchestrationAuthority: Transport and handler invocation only; business orchestration delegates to packages/application-services and event flow delegates to packages/orchestration.
eventAuthority: Owns runtime event ingress, handler execution, acknowledgement, and correlation propagation for this service boundary; event contracts live in packages/orchestration and packages/event-core.
workflowAuthority: Workflows, use cases, sequencing, and cross-domain coordination are owned by packages/application-services, not this runtime.
queryAuthority: Executes service-side reads through application-services or runtime-composition contracts; does not own cross-domain projection assembly.
compositionAuthority: Owns API, worker, webhook, scheduler, queue, and response-envelope composition only; no UI or business workflow composition.
executionOwnership: Execution container for APIs, workers, schedulers, queues, webhooks, event handlers, transport, and runtime bootstrapping only.
distributedExecutionOwnership: Owns execution-container wiring for durable distributed execution while event persistence, queues, checkpoints, coordination, resilience, cache, telemetry, tenant scaling, and regional contracts are defined in packages/distributed-runtime.
queueOwnership: Owns queue execution containers, retry scheduling, visibility timeout handling, dead-letter redrive, and worker coordination for declared service responsibilities using packages/distributed-runtime contracts.
providerOwnership: May bind packages/infrastructure adapters to deployment secrets and runtime bindings; direct provider SDK imports are forbidden outside packages/infrastructure.
executionBoundaries: Execution-container boundary: APIs, workers, queues, schedulers, webhooks, runtime bootstrapping, and execution adapters only.
asyncExecutionOwnership: Owns runtime async containers only: queue consumers, webhook handlers, schedulers, and event workers while workflow policy delegates to application-services/orchestration.
observabilityOwnership: Propagates request, correlation, trace, and audit metadata across API, queue, webhook, scheduler, and execution adapter boundaries.
telemetryOwnership: Owns execution-container telemetry emission for traces, queue/workflow/replay spans, metrics, structured logs, and correlation propagation using packages/distributed-runtime contracts.
workflowRecoveryOwnership: Owns execution-container checkpoint and recovery wiring only; workflow recovery policy delegates to packages/application-services and packages/orchestration.
recoveryOwnership: Owns runtime recovery wiring for queue retries, workflow continuation, replay checkpoints, projection rebuilds, and dead-letter redrive while policy delegates to application-services/orchestration/distributed-runtime.
replayOwnership: Owns replay execution containers when worker, scheduler, webhook, or API runtime requires them; replay policy and contracts delegate to packages/orchestration.
checkpointOwnership: Owns runtime checkpoint persistence wiring for workflows, queue consumers, replays, and projections while checkpoint contracts live in packages/distributed-runtime and projection-runtime.
projectionOwnership: No local projection policy ownership; service-side read models and projections use packages/runtime-composition contracts.
cqrsOwnership: Owns execution-container command/query wiring only; command authority delegates to application-services and read-model/projection consistency delegates to runtime-composition/projection-runtime.
cacheOwnership: Owns service-side cache invalidation and projection cache coordination for declared runtime responsibilities; cache policy contracts live in runtime-composition, projection-runtime, and distributed-runtime.
coordinationOwnership: Owns runtime coordination wiring for worker leases, execution locks, fencing tokens, heartbeats, leader election metadata, and ownership failover using packages/distributed-runtime.
resilienceOwnership: Owns runtime resilience wiring for retries, circuit breakers, provider fallback, degradation handling, and provider health telemetry through packages/distributed-runtime and packages/infrastructure.
regionalOwnership: Owns runtime region-aware execution wiring, Cloudflare deployment locality, tenant affinity, and failover metadata while global routing contracts live in packages/distributed-runtime.
tenantScalingOwnership: Owns tenant-aware execution wiring for quotas, rate governance, queue partitioning, noisy-neighbor protection, and tenant runtime metrics using packages/distributed-runtime contracts.
auditOwnership: Owns execution audit emission for privileged runtime operations, replay authorization, provider execution, queue redrive, and workflow recovery using packages/distributed-runtime security contracts.
operationalOwnership: Owns execution-container operational wiring for runtime health, diagnostics, recovery orchestration, deployment topology participation, and operational command handling.
telemetryExecutionOwnership: Owns execution-container telemetry emission for traces, metrics, structured logs, diagnostics, queue/replay/workflow spans, and exporter abstraction wiring.
replayExecutionOwnership: Owns replay execution-container wiring for scheduling, authorization checks, dry-runs, checkpoint coordination, rollback planning, and replay telemetry.
queueExecutionOwnership: Owns queue operational execution for inspection, recovery, retry orchestration, visibility timeout repair, dead-letter redrive, partition balancing, and throughput diagnostics.
resilienceExecutionOwnership: Owns resilience execution wiring for circuit breakers, adaptive retries, provider failover, degraded mode, outage coordination, fallback execution, and recovery telemetry.
regionalExecutionOwnership: Owns region-aware execution wiring for locality, failover, regional queue ownership, replication diagnostics, and global execution metadata.
auditExecutionOwnership: Owns runtime audit execution for replay authorization, provider execution, queue redrive, workflow recovery, tenant runtime operations, and control-plane commands.
cacheExecutionOwnership: Owns service-side cache execution for invalidation, stale-while-revalidate coordination, replay-aware invalidation, cache diagnostics, and tenant cache partitioning.
coordinationExecutionOwnership: Owns distributed coordination execution for worker leases, locks, fencing tokens, heartbeats, leader election, failover transfer, and collision recovery.
diagnosticsOwnership: Owns runtime diagnostics persistence for queue, replay, workflow, projection, cache, provider, regional, tenant, telemetry, and deployment health.
operationalControlPlaneOwnership: Owns operational control-plane command execution for replay, workflow, queue, diagnostics, resilience, telemetry, tenant runtime, governance, and recovery orchestration.
deploymentOwnership: Owns production execution deployment wiring for Notification Service; provider manifests are declared in runtime topology and service deployment config.
observabilityInfrastructureOwnership: Emits correlated runtime telemetry to the OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Tempo, Loki, and Grafana stack declared in infrastructure/observability.
queueProviderOwnership: Delegates production queue provider execution to services/api-gateway producers and services/queue-workers consumers.
eventStoreOwnership: Delegates event persistence to packages/distributed-runtime contracts backed by Supabase Postgres append-only event store.
failoverOwnership: Owns runtime failover participation through control-plane commands, health checks, and regional diagnostics.
incidentOwnership: Participates in incident metadata, diagnostics, alert routing, and audit records through production incident governance.
deploymentTopologyOwnership: Must match config/runtime/deployment-topology.json and config/runtime/production-topology.json; topology drift is a hard validation failure.
securityOwnership: Owns runtime secret binding, RBAC enforcement, audit emission, and operational authorization for service execution.
chaosOwnership: Participates in approved chaos experiments recorded in chaos_experiment_runs with guardrails and rollback commands.
loadTestingOwnership: Participates in k6/Gatling/Locust production-readiness benchmarks recorded in load_test_runs.
controlPlaneOwnership: Owns service-side operational command execution or projection through /v1/operations/runtime and runtime_control_commands.
regionalRoutingOwnership: Owns region-aware execution metadata, tenant affinity, failover routing, and regional diagnostics for service work.
